node.html:
• Developed an intelligent captcha breaker to be used as a pre-filling tool in application forms. Applied morphological techniques, de-skew letters and transformed into a processing pipeline. Trained a custom DL model on processed letters of 28 classes to improve accuracy more than standard OCR.
  • Developed a continuous learning module for new incoming data and fine-tuning the pre-trained model and its integration along with the inference pipeline into the existing Flask microservice.
A virtual conversational assistant for tourism in India integrated with Whatsapp. Shortisted in Finale of SIH 2020 Software Edition. Read more about it on Medium Post.

Code Implementation of a paper on Adaptive Mammographic Image Enhancement. The goal of the project was to enhance the breast mammographic images so as to ease the detection of micro-calcifications or granular masses that may be malignant.

• Developed a Vehicle Detection and Counting model for an edge device, converted into tflite equivalent, both quantized and non-quantized. Processed frames from an IP camera and optimized the frames per second, finally deployed using Flask.
  • Developed another approach to sent frames from edge to aws S3 bucket, processed on ec2 machine and deployed using Elastic IP. Retrieve location of camera, region, time and maintained a database for the statistics of the vehicle counting after a fixed interval.

frontmatter.title: FORID - Field Orbiting robot to Identify Disease

node.html: A robot to orbit around the field and map diseased areas. An Android App to display the map and send the data on the cloud. Shortislted for the Google Build For Digital India Regionals.
Sentiment Analysis and classification using NLP techniques on Twitter dataset. It was a part of a challenge on Analytics Vidhya in which I secured in top 50 of the leaderboard.

• Worked on a Vision-aided Robot (6 DOF arm) to perform different tasks as communicated from server running on Nvidia Jetson Nano. Applied IP techniques to detect colour, circles, pattern, OCR, QRcodes and calculate transformation matrix to direct Robot’s TCP to the target location on object so as to perform the designated task.
  • Semantic Segmentation of metal surface defects based on pixel encodings, used U-Net and dice loss to generate masks on test images.
Generation of artistic images using Style Transfer.
A Segmantic segmentation of lung fields in chest X-rays using U-net (a network of UpSampling in convolutions)
A web application deployed on Node.js to classify spam/non-spam messages using Multinomial Naive Bayes algorithm.
Optimization of different parameters for 4 different materials as layers so as to absorb radio-waves in X-Band.
